name: manual-settlement-reconciliation
objective: Replace legacy bank/provider payout semantics with verified official-wallet destinations, immutable manual settlement execution, reconciliation, treasury controls and daily close.
truthOwner: WLT owns destinations, payout holds/snapshots, batches, evidence, reconciliation, treasury control projections and close state.

tasks.objective: Replace bank/mobile/manual destination semantics with versioned verified OfficialWalletDestination.
tasks.currentProblem: Current payout destination model carries bank/IBAN fields and uses manual as a settlement preference, conflating where money goes with how it is executed.
tasks.requiredChange: Create official-wallet provider/destination identity, supported-provider policy binding, encrypted reference, masked projection and verification lifecycle; material identifier change creates a new unverified version.
tasks.targetState: Only one verified active destination version per governed scope can be selected for payout and old versions remain auditable.
tasks.action: Use forward migration to preserve legacy destination history, map only provable official-wallet rows, and require finance re-verification where semantics are ambiguous.
mustNotChange: Do not treat manual as a destination type.
Do not expose raw destination identifiers by default.
Do not infer verification from legacy active=true.
acceptanceCriteria: Sensitive reference is encrypted and masked in normal readback.
Unverified destination cannot enter an approved payout snapshot.
tasks.rollback: Retain legacy fields read-only until migration evidence is complete; do not reactivate bank/provider semantics as rollback.

tasks.objective: Enforce payout eligibility, holds, immutable approval snapshots and server-side separation of duties.
tasks.currentProblem: Current payout flow has governance primitives but provider-oriented statuses and insufficient proof that approval freezes all material facts.
tasks.requiredChange: Compute withdrawal eligibility server-side by source/policy, hold eligible funds idempotently, bind approval to immutable beneficiary/destination-version/amount/currency/policy snapshot, and enforce maker/checker role transitions.
tasks.targetState: No actor can request above eligible value; material changes require a new approval object and the same identity cannot bypass configured SoD.
tasks.action: Extend payout state machine/audit and permissions; migrate legacy requests into explicit historical/compatibility states without inventing approvals.
mustNotChange: Do not equate visible wallet balance with withdrawable amount.
Do not mutate approved snapshot in place.
Do not release hold on ambiguous post-execution state.
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent payout requests cannot over-hold wallet value.
Approval snapshot hash/material fields are immutable.
Unauthorized/self-conflicting role transition is denied and audited.
tasks.rollback: Release only pre-execution holds through a governed transition; preserve executed/unknown cases for reconciliation.

tasks.objective: Build immutable SettlementBatch and controlled XLSX/export artifact workflow.
tasks.currentProblem: Manual execution needs batching but spreadsheets must not become financial truth or a mutable approval surface.
tasks.requiredChange: Group approved snapshots into provider/currency-scoped batches, freeze exact rows/control totals/hash, generate audited XLSX from the snapshot, and hash/register the artifact.
tasks.targetState: Frozen batch rows cannot change; regenerated artifacts remain traceable to the same canonical snapshot and manual edits do not mutate WLT.
tasks.action: Extend existing settlement primitives and add constraints/idempotency around batch creation/freeze/export.
mustNotChange: Do not import arbitrary edited XLSX as ledger truth.
Do not allow beneficiary/amount edits after freeze.
Do not create duplicate batches for the same approved snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate batch/export requests are idempotent or conflict safely.
tasks.rollback: Unfreeze only by explicit cancellation before external execution; otherwise create a new corrective batch.

tasks.objective: Implement manual execution evidence, independent verification and four-way reconciliation before payout completion.
tasks.currentProblem: Provider-processing paths can currently advance payout state without the target manual external evidence chain.
tasks.requiredChange: Record external transfer reference/evidence per batch row, enforce uniqueness, require independent verification, ingest authoritative statement/record idempotently, and reconcile approved snapshot + frozen row + execution evidence + statement.
tasks.targetState: No bare mark-paid transition exists; mismatch/duplicate/missing evidence creates a blocking reconciliation exception.
tasks.action: Disable active provider payout submission for the current product model, retain historical provider records, and route completion exclusively through reconciliation.
mustNotChange: Do not call provider CashOut APIs in the current production model.
Do not complete from screenshot/operator assertion alone.
Do not retry executed/unknown transfer as a new payout.
acceptanceCriteria: Completion requires the four required facts to agree.
Mismatch remains held/blocked and auditable until resolved.
tasks.rollback: For uncertain execution, preserve hold and evidence then reconcile; never roll back by deleting the external action record.

tasks.objective: Add treasury control projection, SettlementAuditPack and DailyFinanceClose blocking gates.
tasks.currentProblem: Per-transfer reconciliation alone does not prove BThwani external wallet balances or that a business day has no unresolved material exposure.
tasks.requiredChange: Track expected/actual official-wallet external account balances as reconciliation control facts, compile immutable audit packs, and block daily close on missing evidence, unmatched statements, control-total differences, unresolved material exceptions or role violations.
tasks.targetState: Finance can explain every completed payout and cannot close a day with blocking exposure.
tasks.action: Build projections from WLT obligations/evidence rather than a second ledger; use server business date/cutoff and append-only close/audit events.
mustNotChange: Do not create a treasury ledger parallel to WLT.
Do not use device clock as financial close authority.
Do not reopen a closed day by mutating historical facts.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit pack links payout, batch, execution, statement and ledger IDs.
Any blocking exception makes close fail closed.
tasks.rollback: Correct post-close discoveries with governed next-period adjustments/reopen policy, never in-place history mutation.
